about.title: Rohnert Park Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Rohnert Park's busiest streets — Rohnert Park Expressway, Redwood Drive, and Golf Course Drive — see a steady flow of daily commuters, shoppers, and students, and public records show 85 injury collisions and 107 injured people in the most recent year, with Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. showing the heaviest reporting. Whether your crash happened near a Sonoma County intersection or on the Expressway itself, the days right after matter. Insurance adjusters often reach out quickly, sometimes before you've had a chance to see a doctor or understand the extent of your injuries. LawProactive doesn't practice law — we simply connect Rohnert Park residents with an independent personal injury attorney who can evaluate what happened, deal with the insurance company on your behalf, and help you understand your options, all without any upfront cost to you.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before the Insurer

items.title: California's Clock Is Ticking
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of the crash to file a personal injury lawsuit in California, but that window shrinks dramatically — sometimes to six months — if a government vehicle or road defect was involved. An attorney can help you figure out which deadline applies before you lose the chance to act.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Work Against You
items.desc: California allows recovery even if you were partly at fault, but any percentage assigned to you reduces your compensation. Insurers know this and often try to shift blame onto you early, which is one reason a recorded statement to their adjuster can backfire.

items.title: No Cap on What You've Actually Lost
items.desc: California doesn't limit non-economic damages like pain and suffering in car accident cases, so preserving evidence — photos, witness names, medical records — from the start matters more than people realize. An attorney can help make sure nothing gets lost before it counts.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid this until you've spoken with an attorney. Adjusters are trained to ask questions that can be used to minimize your claim, and anything you say can be taken out of context later. An independent attorney can talk with you about how to handle these calls.

items.question: What if my accident happened on Rohnert Park Expressway or near a city intersection?
items.answer: If a city vehicle, traffic signal malfunction, or road hazard contributed to the crash, you may be dealing with a government entity, which comes with a much shorter claim deadline — sometimes just six months. Because of this, it's important to act quickly and get your facts documented as soon as possible after the collision.

items.question: How much does it cost to get connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service, and the attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no fee to talk with someone about what happened.
